answer_1.quote: We design ternary questions that enable efficient response processing by checking if the answer starts with "yes," "no," or "unsure."
answer_1.outputs: Ternary (yes/no/unsure) answers to probing questions about underspecified sentences

answer_2.quote: We define the following measurements: Disambiguation Accuracy (DA), Unsure Rate (UR), Inconsistency Rate (IR), Consistency Rate 1 (CR1), Consistency Rate 2 (CR2), and Visual Perception Accuracy (VPA).
